rules.statement: A wife should be given notice when a mortgage bond is put in suit by the mortgagee, even if the property was conveyed to her under section 13 of the Matrimonial Rights Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Even assuming that the conveyance were a voluntary conveyance, still it would be subject to the husband's debts, and Somiel should have had notice when the debt was claimed and the bond put in suit."
